notes.title: Shortcuts and Map: Build 0.54 Update
notes.notes:
In this update we added this new features and enhancements:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/shortcuts_map.jpg[/img]

* Nice looking minimap with new overlays
* Keyboard shortccts for inventory and switching players
* Companions are interacting with full animations (example: Urga for the lever in the crypt)

notes.title: Minimap: Build 0.52 Update
notes.notes:
We included a minimap and some new enemies in the new build:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/minimap_3.jpg[/img]

The colors of the minimap are the following:

Green = Player
Blue = Companion
Red = Enemy

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/minimap.jpg[/img]

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/minimap_2.jpg[/img]

Please give us feedback on this feature or ideas for enhancement.

notes.title: Features Build 0.51: Update
notes.notes:
Update of Erwin's Timewarp is available with new features:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/update_051_etw.jpg[/img]

* New timezone middle ages
* Crypt scene added
* Keyboard shortcuts on action menu
* New companions
* Conversations with companions
* New inventory

Also see it in action on youtube:

https://youtu.be/7UnJCXyTc40

notes.title: Middle ages update
notes.notes:
We made it, here is the first update of Erwin's Timewarp in the Middle Ages:

This is were you spawn:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/etw_medieval.jpg[/img]

We are so happy that we could solve all our migration problems and can proceed the development as we planned.

Here is an image of a crypt you will discover in this timezone:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/etw_crypt.jpg[/img]

For those of you guys who solved all puzzles of the first timezone we included the possibility to start directly in the second one:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/etw_start_menu.jpg[/img]

Please send us a message if you find bugs or other annoying stuff, we are able to fix these now faster than before.

Planned updates:

* Finish this timezone
* Controller support
* Sounds and music

Have fun with the new version... next update will follow soon.
